title: Avoid This Beginner Data Analyst Mistake
description:
One of the biggest mistakes you might make when facing a data analytics error is saying, "I'm stuck"

And expecting someone to swoop in and save the day.

Stop doing that!

How can others help when what you share is very vague?

Instead of saying, "I don't know what's going wrong," try to give more details.

For example, "I tried to join these two tables but keep getting an error message that says 'Error 1042'.

That way, whoever is trying to help you can pinpoint exactly where the problem might be.

What about you?

Have you ever been stuck on a coding problem and unsure how to ask for help?
